meta.title: Sticky wall
meta.description: A note wall for ideas. Click Sticky wall in the sidebar (below More) to open it. Write in the box at the top, pick a paper colour, then press Add to wall or ⌘/Ctrl + Enter. Each note shows its category and time; click the pencil to edit the category and text, or Delete inside the editor. Deleting shows an Undo button for 8 seconds. The search box filters notes as you type. Notes are saved in this browser profile only and survive restarts; they are not written to the session log or shared with other devices.
